beats.premise: As the scientist's rant crescendos, the time distortion supercharges, accelerating everything in the room into chaos.
beats.action: The green crystals pulse and spin faster; debris orbits chaotically. The scientist staggers backward, eyes wide as his voice warbles into an inhuman frequency. The boy braces himself against the wall.
beats.ending_pose: The scientist has one hand raised toward the vortex center, mouth open mid-syllable; the boy clutches the wall with wide eyes.
visible_consequences: Crystals glow bright acid-green and orbit at high speed
The scientist's hair whips upward against the vortex pull
Cracks radiate outward from where the boy grips the wall

children.premise: The acceleration reaches critical mass; the vortex opens and begins pulling the room's contents—and the scientist—inward irreversibly.
children.action: The scientist's hand is sucked into the vortex with a silent scream. The boy launches himself toward his grandfather. Lab equipment spirals into the void, splintering. The scientist grabs at the air to escape, but his arm is already halfway in.
children.ending_pose: The scientist is half-absorbed into the vortex center, one arm outstretched toward the boy; the boy has jumped forward, arm reaching back.
visible_consequences: The scientist's torso and one arm are translucent, phasing out
Laboratory equipment shatters violently entering the void
A terrible silence envelops the scene

children.premise: As the scientist is consumed, the vortex's pull intensifies; the boy cannot hold on and is drawn in as well.
children.action: The scientist's outstretched hand slips through the boy's grasp. The boy's feet leave the floor as the vortex pulls. He screams silently. His yellow shirt flutters and tears. The scientist's hand dissipates into light. The boy is pulled into the void, still reaching backward.
children.ending_pose: Both figures are phasing out, disappearing into the vortex center; only faint translucent outlines remain visible.
visible_consequences: Both characters are half-absorbed and fading
The boy's yellow shirt is shredded and trailing
The vortex glows brighter as it consumes them

children.premise: The boy, seeing his grandfather vanishing, lunges forward and manages to grab the scientist's free arm, bracing against the floor.
children.action: The boy plants his feet and pulls with all his strength. The scientist's absorption slows and reverses slightly. The boy's face contorts with effort. For a moment, escape seems possible. But the vortex pulls harder. The scientist's eyes lock with the boy's before the pull intensifies. The boy's grip begins to slip.
children.ending_pose: The boy has both hands locked around the scientist's arm; their bodies are angled at dangerous tension against the vortex pull.
visible_consequences: The boy's feet slide on the floor despite all effort
Cracks spider-web from where the boy's heels drag against the floor
The scientist's face shows both fear and gratitude

children.premise: The scientist's rage sharpens into focus; he shouts an incomprehensible command and begins channeling the vortex's energy, turning chaos into control.
children.action: The scientist plants his feet and throws both hands outward in a commanding gesture. His rant shifts from panicked to authoritative. The vortex's spin slows, then reverses. The boy stumbles backward, startled by the shift. Crystals slow their orbit, responding to the scientist's gesture.
children.ending_pose: The scientist stands with legs braced wide, both arms spread in a commanding V-shape; the boy tumbles backward, shocked.
visible_consequences: Green light pulses in rhythm with the scientist's gesture
The scientist's hair crackles with purposeful energy
Debris slows its chaotic spin into orderly orbits

children.premise: The scientist's attempt to command the vortex backfires; the energy flows back toward him in a devastating pulse.
children.action: The vortex responds, but the feedback is violent. A shockwave erupts, throwing both figures backward. The scientist's commanding expression contorts into shock. He crashes across the room. The boy crashes into furniture. The scientist's overreach is now clear.
children.ending_pose: Both figures are airborne, tumbling backward; the scientist's face shows realization of his mistake.
visible_consequences: The scientist's white lab coat is torn and scorched
Furniture is overturned and splintered behind the boy's trajectory
The green light flickers violently, destabilized

children.premise: The scientist's command holds perfectly; the vortex condenses and stabilizes into a controlled, manageable form.
children.action: The green energy responds to his will. Crystals arrange into precise geometric patterns. The vortex shrinks to a stable sphere at the room's center. The scientist's expression shifts from commanding to satisfied. He lowers his hands slowly. The boy watches in awe. Chaos transforms into containment.
children.ending_pose: The scientist stands with arms crossed, looking at the stabilized sphere; the boy has moved to his side, also staring at the contained vortex.
visible_consequences: The vortex is now a stable, pulsing sphere the size of a beach ball
Green crystals form an intricate geometric cage around it
Both characters stand unharmed and confident

beats.premise: The scientist's words suddenly reverse; the distortion inverts, pulling inward rather than pushing outward.
beats.action: The green glow flickers and dims. Floating crystals slow and hover. The scientist's rant plays backward—a high-pitched reverse wail. The boy's panic-raised arms lower as if time itself is sinking. Debris drifts downward like sinking bubbles.
beats.ending_pose: Both figures are suspended in eerie quiet; the scientist's expression shifts from ranting anger to confused concern; the boy's arms lower but his face remains tense.
visible_consequences: Green light is now cold, dim, and concentrated at center
Debris floats slowly downward like falling snow in reverse
The scientist's face shows unfamiliar uncertainty, almost fear

children.premise: As time reverses, something that shouldn't exist begins to crystallize in the vortex center—a geometric, impossible shape.
children.action: The central vortex dims to ghostly blue-green. A shape forms—not organic, not mechanical, something mathematically impossible—it phases into visibility. The scientist's expression shifts to terrified. The boy's eyes widen; he points. The entity pulses with internal light, indifferent.
children.ending_pose: Both the scientist and boy are frozen, staring upward; the impossible entity hovers in the center, pulsing slowly.
visible_consequences: A geometric entity made of impossible angles occupies the vortex center
The green light is now cool blue-white, emanating from the entity
Both characters are bathed in this new, alien light

children.premise: The impossible entity notices the two humans; its attention is predatory.
children.action: The entity's light sharpens; geometric edges extend toward the scientist and boy like reaching fingers. Its pulse quickens. The scientist pushes the boy behind him protectively. The entity descends slowly, deliberately. The scientist's fear is evident. Both humans press backward.
children.ending_pose: The scientist is positioned between the entity and the boy, arms spread defensively; the entity hovers close, its edges crackling with energy.
visible_consequences: The entity's geometric extensions are inches from the scientist's face
The room's light is now harsh and blue-white from the entity
The scientist's protective stance belies his fear

children.premise: The entity, having fully formed, is entirely unconcerned with the humans; it exists on a different level of reality.
children.action: The entity phases into the wall and passes through it, as if the room and its inhabitants don't matter. It moves with geometric precision, ignoring the scientist and boy completely. The scientist watches it go, confused and relieved. The boy releases a held breath. The entity dissolves into the far wall, still pulsing.
children.ending_pose: The scientist and boy stand together, watching the entity phase through the wall; the entity is half-absorbed into the structure, ignoring them completely.
visible_consequences: The entity is partially inside the wall structure
The wall behind the entity is warped and crystallized
Both humans look small and insignificant before this uncaring force

children.premise: Time's reversal reaches a threshold and stabilizes; the room settles into a new, eerily quiet state where nothing moves.
children.action: The green glow fades to gentle amber. Floating debris settles onto furniture like dust. The scientist lowers his raised hand slowly, deliberately. The boy's panic softens into confusion. Crystals anchor themselves to surfaces with a subtle chime.
children.ending_pose: Both figures stand in a still room; the scientist's hand is at his side; the boy is upright but uncertain; everything is calm and motionless.
visible_consequences: Debris now rests on every surface like a thin coating
The light is warm amber instead of sickly green
Complete and unnatural silence envelops the scene

children.premise: In the silence and stillness, the scientist realizes the terrible truth—they're not in equilibrium, they're trapped in temporal stasis.
children.action: The scientist tries to move but finds his motion slowed dramatically, as if moving through invisible gel. He gestures urgently to the boy, who also tries and realizes the constraint. The scientist's face shifts to dawning horror. His watch is frozen. He touches floating debris and feels its immovable weight. His eyes widen with understanding.
children.ending_pose: The scientist is mid-stride, unable to complete the motion; the boy is beside him, frozen in a reaching gesture; both faces show comprehension of their predicament.
visible_consequences: The scientist's watch is frozen at the same moment as entry
Floating debris is now solid and immobile despite being airborne
Both characters' expressions show realization of their trap

children.premise: The boy discovers he's not fully trapped—he can move, slowly, through the crystallized time around them.
children.action: The boy deliberately takes a step and finds, with effort, he can move. The scientist remains partially frozen. The boy's eyes widen with possibility. He reaches down and picks up floating debris—it comes free, incredibly heavy but moveable. He looks at his grandfather, trapped. The boy realizes he might navigate this crystallized world. He takes another step. A faint smile crosses his face.
children.ending_pose: The boy has taken a deliberate step forward, holding a piece of debris; the scientist remains partially frozen behind him; the boy's face shows determination and hope.
visible_consequences: The boy's footprints are visible in the crystalline stasis floor
The debris he holds proves movement is possible
The scientist's frozen form contrasts with the boy's newfound agency
